decisions.reason: As a close-fit formulation to the firm's existing pharmaceutical know-how and marketed with a dedicated page, it is well within the firm's absorptive capacity to refine and commercialize.

Because this generic antidepressant is described as distant from the established offer, the firm is less able to leverage prior therapeutic-market knowledge and is more likely to reallocate resources if early results are only moderate.

This combination antihypertensive film tablet closely matches the firm's formulation, manufacturing, and regulatory capabilities, so management is likely to keep learning from the launch rather than exit quickly.
Although it is less prominently presented, the supplement builds on the firm's self-care and pharmacy-channel business and fits its strategic aim to grow differentiated non-reimbursement products.
